required_capabilities: hostname verification or an explicitly reviewed equivalent binding

source_qualification.tag_commit_relation: relay explicitly verified v5.9.2-stable resolves to ac01707f552c611fbd135cc723b2682b3e7f80f2

m2a_local_qualification.valid_case: DTLSv1.3 / TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 and application datagram round trip passed for wbd.test
m2a_local_qualification.hostname_mismatch: rejected by native handshake verification with peer subject name mismatch
m2a_local_qualification.untrusted_ca: rejected by native handshake verification with ASN no signer

m2b_local_qualification.direct: 5/5 bidirectional UDP datagrams; one wolfSSL_write/read per plaintext datagram/record
m2b_local_qualification.drop_gate: quiet-default shim requalified: after handshake and idle, deterministic proxy dropped next client-to-server encrypted application datagram; msg-01 absent while msg-02/msg-03 were authenticated, decrypted and echoed
m2b_local_qualification.trace_policy: per-record WRITE/READ tracing is disabled by default; WBD_DTLS_TRACE=1 enables it for diagnostics

m2c_local_qualification.topology: UDPspeeder mode0 FEC -> WBD DTLS 1.3 -> udp2raw FakeTCP, one lane
m2c_local_qualification.primary_profile: 20:20; 50 ms RTT; 200 x 256 B; window32; warmup64; encrypted-record loss 0/1/5/10/15%; seeds 260824/260825/260826
m2c_local_qualification.primary_result: 15/15 cases delivered 200/200; median p99 70.5/71.9/76.2/69.8/82.1 ms for 0/1/5/10/15%; median DTLS byte overhead vs M1 FEC approximately 5.2-5.4%
m2c_local_qualification.outlier_policy: formal raw results preserve individual host-scheduling outliers; deterministic repeat diagnostics are reported separately and do not replace formal cases

dtls.license_note: wolfSSL 5.9.x is available under GPLv3 and commercial licensing. Review redistribution/linking obligations before product packaging.
dtls.qualification_rule: M2 is locally qualified for one DTLS association on the one-lane pinned UDPspeeder/udp2raw carrier. Proceed to native WBD session/control inside DTLS. Two lanes, kernel-anchor, TUN and Auto remain gated by later milestones.
